result: Keep the native bounded WP710 scheduler. Do not import an external scheduler. Promote one exact falsifier: same-target intents with different freshness/deadline/permission constraints must not be conflated unless the retained request semantically dominates the discarded request. Secondary falsifiers cover pre-dispatch source starvation and the semantics of recent drop IDs.
handoff: Trigger 4 should test the coalescing counterexample before WP710 acceptance and repair only if reproduced.
